description.zh: 创建频道时间，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
description.en: Channel Creation Time. Supports querying data from the last 30 days. Represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

description.zh:
频道释放时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
> 如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据。
description.en:
Channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. An empty parameter indicates retrieving data up to the current time.  
> If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the Creation Time to the actual release time will be returned.

title.zh: 单次通信中下行体验质量指标
title.en: Downlink Quality of Experience Metrics for a Single Communication Session

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于获取单次通信中用户的下行体验质量指标。例如：您可以获取影响通信体验的指标类型、音视频指标趋势图等信息。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to obtain the downlink experience quality metrics of a user in a single communication session. For example, you can retrieve information such as the metric types that impact communication experience and audio/video trend indicators.  
### QPS Limit  
The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may affect your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
